key_insight: Neural triage decoding adaptively allocates computation to achieve high accuracy and low latency for ultra-high-rate quantum LDPC codes.
engineering_relevance: The approach could reduce decoding bottlenecks in low-overhead quantum error correction by reserving expensive computation for difficult error patterns.
method: Use a local neural message-passing network to rapidly predict error corrections.
Apply additional iterations when residual syndrome violations remain.
Rarely invoke a diversification stage to search for syndrome-consistent corrections.
evidence_signal: On lifted-product and Kasai codes encoding hundreds of logical qubits, the abstract reports accuracy comparable to near-optimal algorithmic decoders with approximately 10–100× lower decoding latency.
watch_item: Real-time deployment requires checking worst-case latency from difficult shots and ensuring syndrome-consistent corrections do not introduce logical errors.
paper_title: Fast and accurate neural triage decoding of ultra-high-rate quantum LDPC codes
